subtitle: Lesson 7 · Update Sets at Scale

code:
Update Set B references a Script Include
  defined in Update Set A

A not yet promoted -> preview error on B

Fix: promote A first, then re-preview B
caption: Force-pushing through the error does not make the dependency exist.

code:
Preview flags a record: SKIPPED

Wrong:  click past, it wasn't an error
Right:  review what was skipped and why
        before accepting the preview
caption: Skipping something that mattered leaves a subtly broken target instance.

code:
Commit sequence:  1  2  3  [network drop]  4  5

Target instance now has: 1, 2, 3 applied
                          4, 5 NOT applied
caption: A messy, half-applied state that needs careful record-by-record investigation.
